title: Andrei Zavo | Promo & Social Media Videographer for Growing Brands
description: I’m Andrei Zavo, a promo and social media videographer creating short-form videos, reels, and TikTok content that help brands grow, engage audiences, and stand out online.

intro.heading: Let’s tell your story, month after month.
intro.text: You focus on your craft. I’ll handle the camera, the edit, and the delivery.

points.title: Shot on site, always
points.body: Every frame is filmed at your place — nothing stock, nothing generic.

points.title: A steady creative rhythm
points.body: A fixed set of videos each month, so your story keeps unfolding.

points.title: Just you and me
points.body: I film, edit, and deliver everything myself, from first shot to final cut.

processIntro.heading: From first call to final cut.

process.title: We talk
process.body: We talk about what you want your brand to say, then set up your shooting schedule. I usually film in batches of 3–4 videos per session.

process.title: Scripts and ideas
process.body: Before each shoot, I send you the scripts and ideas we’re going to film. No surprises on shooting day.

process.title: We film
process.body: I come to you and we film the batch in one relaxed session. You show up as yourself, I handle the rest.

process.title: I edit
process.body: I edit, and we fine-tune together until every video feels right.

process.title: Delivery and posting
process.body: You get the finished videos. Post them yourself, or let me help you publish them.
